EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very strong band at 2234 cm⁻¹ consistent with a nitrile C≡N stretch, and an intense ring-breathing mode at 1003 cm⁻¹ that is characteristic of a para-substituted benzene. Aromatic C=C stretches at 1605 and 1585 cm⁻¹, aromatic/aliphatic C–H stretches at 3073 and 2930 cm⁻¹ (supported by GFQ-003), and a CH₃ deformation near 1382 cm⁻¹ further support a p-methylbenzonitrile structure. Candidate 10 (Cc1ccc(C#N)cc1) matches these features best, whereas candidates lacking an aromatic nitrile or showing other functional groups (e.g., alkyne, isocyanate, azo) are less consistent.
